title: [UI/UX] Recovery Potential Flag — Dependency
walkthroughSteps: Navigate to /claims/CLM-2024-001/overview — claim is open, so the recovery potential edit link is visible

walkthroughSteps.title: Recovery potential
walkthroughSteps.body: Set/Update next to the Recovery potential card lets a handler flag whether recovery is possible on this claim.
walkthroughSteps.expectedAfterClick: Opens the recovery potential modal — choosing Yes/No (with an optional note for No) updates the chip shown on the card.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Recovery potential can be set or updated from the overview
acceptanceCriteria.plainStatement: The **Recovery potential** card's Set/Update link opens a modal to flag recovery potential Yes/No, with an optional note.

setup.description: CLM-2024-001 is open by default — no override needed

preconditions.text: Recovery potential card shows Set or Update

expectedUI.description: Recovery potential modal opens with Yes/No selection
visualCues: Selecting No reveals an optional note field

howToTest.trigger: Click Set/Update on the Recovery potential card
howToTest.expectedResult: Modal opens; confirming updates the card's chip
